_comment: QA-focus FAST pass. Coarse field-map grid (20x40x20 vs the production 48x96x48 that stalled >18 min in Biot-Savart on many-coil devices) + fewer coil segments (128) -- b_hat is smooth so this is safe, and it is consistent across configs so eta_source stays comparable. Batches halved (2M histories, ~0.3% error, plenty for the +-10% coil signal). QH devices are queued separately in qh_queue.json (they geometry_fold and need a thinner build / ParaStell).
